subject: Mental Models
title: Opportunity Cost
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Opportunity Cost.

hook.text: You spend Saturday watching movies. The cost is not $15 for the ticket.

buildup.text: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative you give up when making a choice.

discovery.text: Friedrich von Wieser formalized this in 1914. Resources spent one way cannot be spent another.

twist.text: People obsess over direct costs and ignore opportunity costs.

punchline.text: Every choice has an invisible price tag.

quiz.question: Who formalized the concept of opportunity cost?
